_about: What locals know: notes a newcomer only finds out by trying, written by hand for one country at a time and never templated across countries. A country with no notes shows nothing. Each note is a label of at most seven words over one fact of at most 140 characters; at most five notes a country.

GB.label: Registering is fast, payroll is not
GB.fact: A sole trader can register online in an afternoon. Setting up an employer scheme to run payroll is the step that actually takes time.

GB.label: The headline rent is not the rent
GB.fact: On a strong high street, rates and service charge can add a third again on top of the quoted figure.

GB.label: Small premises often pay less
GB.fact: Each nation of the United Kingdom runs a rate relief for small premises, and the thresholds differ, so check the one where the shop sits.

GB.label: The first hire triggers a pension
GB.fact: Hiring a first employee triggers pension auto-enrolment, so budget for the on-cost from the first payslip, not later.
